title: docs(core): document selection and range editing APIs
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Document the core selection and atomic range-editing APIs in the package and bilingual root READMEs, and refresh the roadmap summary to match the detailed roadmap.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

The detailed roadmap marks `getSelectedText()`, multi-cursor support, regex search, slash sorting, and framework `onReady` support as shipped, while the root README still presents them as upcoming work. The root API reference also omits the already-public selection and `replaceRange()` APIs, making host integrations harder to discover.

- Issue: N/A — documentation consistency fix
- Roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`): Core Editor #5 and Developer Experience #24
- OpenSpec change: N/A — documentation-only change; no capability or behavior change

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`: expand the selections section with `getSelectedText()`, `replaceSelection()`, and atomic `replaceRange()` semantics, including main-range and pre-edit-offset behavior.
- Root documentation: add the same selection/range-editing surface to the English and Chinese API references.
- Roadmap summary: remove already-shipped P0/P1 highlights and reflect the remaining planned work in both languages.
- `packages/plugin-*`: N/A
- `apps/electron-demo`: N/A
- `openspec/`: N/A

## Testing / 测试

- [ ] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — not run; documentation-only change
- [ ] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 — not run; no source or package metadata changed
- [x] Cross-checked every documented method against `EditorAPI` in `packages/core/src/types.ts`
- [x] Verified English/Chinese API parity and balanced Markdown code fences
- [x] Re-fetched the committed branch and confirmed all three files exactly match the validated content
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证 — not applicable

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will follow the CLA bot prompt
- [x] **AI disclosure**: this PR changes documentation only; no functional code was generated. AI assistance drafted and reviewed the documentation and cross-checked it against the public TypeScript API.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`)
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API documentation is synchronized with the existing types; no API behavior changed
- [x] `live-preview-table.ts` was not touched
- [x] No new capability or breaking change; OpenSpec is not required
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (`GOVERNANCE.md` §4)

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏

N/A — documentation-only change.

 ```ts
 editor.getDocument()          // current Markdown string
 editor.getAst()               // current mdast Root
-editor.setDocument(md)        // replace entire document
+
+// Selection and range editing
+editor.getSelection()         // main range: { anchor, head }
+editor.getSelections()        // { ranges: [{ anchor, head }, ...], mainIndex }
+editor.getSelectedText()      // text in the main range; "" when collapsed
+editor.setSelection(anchor, head)
+editor.setSelections([{ anchor: 2 }, { anchor: 9, head: 14 }], 1)
+editor.replaceSelection(text)
+editor.replaceRange(from, to, insert, { anchor: nextPos })
+
+// Whole-document replacement
+editor.setDocument(md)
 editor.setDocument(md, { silent: true, preserveSelection: true })
 editor.setDocument(md, { selection: { anchor: 0 } })
-editor.setSelection(pos)      // move cursor
+
 editor.focus() / editor.blur()
 editor.destroy()
 
@@ -224,6 +235,8 @@ editor.off("change", handler)
 editor.getCoordsAtPos(pos)     // { left, right, top, bottom } | null
 ```
 
+`getSelectedText()` reads the main selection range; use `getSelections()` when a host needs every range in multi-cursor mode. `replaceRange()` applies the content change and optional post-edit selection in one CodeMirror transaction, so a single undo restores both. Its offsets use pre-edit document coordinates.

@@ -224,6 +235,8 @@ editor.off("change", handler)

+`getSelectedText()` 只读取主选区；多光标模式下如需所有选区，请使用 `getSelections()`。`replaceRange()` 会在同一个 CodeMirror 事务中完成内容替换和可选的选区移动，因此一次撤销即可同时恢复两者；所有偏移量均基于编辑前的文档坐标。
